items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: And, this other great bass player out there in California, Chandler.

ctx.x: On Capitol. Now, you see, I get to talk like that, and then I get to thinking of some of the people I record with. Sure. And, this other great bass player out there in California, Chandler.
I don't know who you're talking about.
